meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加动态图文叠加层，同步字幕与画面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为访谈或播客视频添加专业图文卡片
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic overlays to videos, synced with transcript
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add professional graphic cards to interview or podcast videos

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 能输入本地视频，自动生成与台词同步的图形卡片（标题、底部注释、数据标注、引用、侧栏、画中画等），叠加在原视频上，并渲染为带图形的 MP4 文件。原始视频内容不变。
howto.when: 当你说“graphic overlays”、“on-screen graphics”、“package my video”等关键词，或要求给视频添加设计图形时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这个访谈视频加上时间同步的图形卡片。
say.note: Claude 会读取视频并设计卡片序列。

say.text: 为我的播客视频制作带数据标注的包装。
say.note: Claude 会分析内容并添加数据卡片。

say.text: 给这段演讲添加画中画和引言的叠层。
say.note: Claude 会在对应位置添加画中画和引言卡片。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude take an existing local video and layer timed graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture) synced to the transcript, then renders the composition to MP4 via hyperframes. The original clip plays untouched.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package my video", or similar phrases about adding designed graphics to a video.

say_en.text: Add timed graphic cards to this interview video.
say_en.note: Claude reads the video and designs card sequence.

say_en.text: Package my podcast video with data callouts.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes content and adds data cards.

say_en.text: Add picture-in-picture and quote overlays to this speech.
say_en.note: Claude adds PiP and quote cards at relevant timestamps.
